title: Chapter 451 Human Teenager
content:
Chapter 451 Human Teenager

Zhen Qingyang's crazy laughter came, and then echoed throughout the Chaos Realm.

Everyone looked at the spreading giant formation, and they were stunned for a moment, a little unable to react.

"This, this is,"

Shi Zhong stared blankly at the formation that was shining with golden light and sometimes sensational aura, his eyes full of shock.

"Such a huge formation is unprecedented."

Wu Hui's face was solemn, but there was a glimmer of hope in the depths of his eyes.

He knew that this was the backup plan made by Lu Xue.

Soon, a figure suddenly appeared in front of everyone.

Zhen Qingyang smiled and saw Lu Xue in the crowd at first glance. He bowed and smiled, "Miss Lu Xue, fortunately, he has finally completed the arrangement of the formation in time."

Then, Zhen Qingyang turned sideways slightly, stretched his arm down, and introduced to everyone: "This array is called the Chaos Combined Attack Formation. It was made up of my study in the deserted city for a long time and arranged it with the deserted city as the array eye. This array has both attack and defense. It can condense the chaotic energy of heaven and earth and feed back to the sentient beings in the Chaos Realm, greatly improving combat power. At the same time, it can also condense the power of sentient beings together and gush out from the deserted city as a carrier, with great power."

"This is the name of joint attack."

Zhen Qingyang stroked his beard with a proud look on his face.

After hearing Zhen Qingyang's introduction, everyone present was the top experts in the Chaos Realm, which naturally means.

"If this fellow Taoist said it is true, then our winning rate will definitely be greatly increased." Wu Hui murmured to himself, with a little expectation in his tone.

And just as everyone was happy, several strange auras came from the hole in the light curtain.

Everyone turned around and saw several powerful men in another world.

In an instant, a strong smell of gunpowder spread out from the air.

"Huh? There is such a powerful suppression effect in this world."

One of the powerful men in another world suddenly frowned and his voice was a little heavy.

When the others heard this, they also felt it and were all very surprised.

"This seems to be a formation."

Another powerful man from another world spoke.

Everyone looked in the direction they pointed, and suddenly they saw a mysterious giant city blooming below.

Seeing this, all the powerful people in other worlds changed their faces.

There is shock, fear, greed, and excitement.

"It seems that we are all muttering about this world. It is definitely not an ordinary person to be able to create such an unprecedented top-level formation."

"No wonder the priest is so concerned about this world. If he can conquer this world and enslave this world, it will definitely be of great benefit to my gods."

The leader said slowly, looking at the deserted city below, with a strong look in his eyes.

A strong man from another world, who was big and thick, smiled arrogantly, "So what if the formation is good? As long as you break the eye of that formation, the formation will be destroyed."

As he said that, this powerful man from another world went straight down, aiming directly at the deserted city.

Seeing this, Lu Xue said coldly: "Stop him!"

Whoosh, whoosh!

Suddenly, three figures shot out, and they were the three human powerhouses, and their cultivation was among the top saint-grade heavenly supreme.

When he saw the person blocking the road, the powerful man in another world laughed, "It's up to you three."

Rumble!

The explosion of offensive continued to gush out, and the three powerful humans fought and retreated, but eventually dragged them down.

Even though this powerful man in another world is among the top immortals, relying on his home court advantage, the three human strongmen are at ease and fight back and forth.

Seeing this scene, the other powerful men in the other world looked slightly darker, and then they took action.

"Go together!"

Lu Xue let out a light roar and took the powerful men in the Chaos Realm to meet him.

So far, their Chaos Realm's strong men still have a numerical advantage, with three or two people fighting against a powerful man from another world, and basically not at a disadvantage.

Lu Xue fought against the strongest aura of the other world alone, and even suppressed the opponent to fight.

"Damn, there are such powerful people in this world."

The powerful man from another world who was fighting against Lu Xue was shocked. No matter how he took action, Lu Xue could always suppress him.

At this time, Lu Xue was not paying attention to her opponent, but outside the Chaos Realm.

The opponent in front of him is not her one-union enemy at all, but she still needs to act. If she takes action to kill this person in seconds, the opponent will definitely send a stronger existence to fight.

This is the case one after another.

At that time, there will always be opponents that Lu Xue cannot defeat.

By then, the Chaos Realm will inevitably be under great pressure.

And like now, the opponent has not realized the strength in the Chaos Realm and will inevitably underestimate the enemy, so what Lu Xue has to do now is to delay time.

When will we wait?

Wait until the large troops from the deserted city rushed back.

Lu Xue will not forget those people. Those people were all recruited by her father himself, and she was thrown into various parts of the universe for further study. After she came back, her absolute strength increased greatly.

At that time, it will not be the land of the gods invading the Chaos Realm, but the Chaos Realm will counterattack the land of the gods.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue suppressed the power in her body and continued to entangle with the powerful people in the other world in front of her.

Rumble!

At this time, another gap in the light curtain exploded, revealing the appearance outside the Chaos Realm.

Seeing this, the hearts of the people in the Chaos Realm sank.

Another group of powerful men from another world rushed in from the gap in the light curtain.

The pressure from the Chaos Realm suddenly increased.

Seeing this, the powerful man from another world who was dragged by the three human powerhouses suddenly burst into laughter, and then shouted loudly: "Go and destroy that city, and the formation in this world will be destroyed without any attack!"

Hearing this, the powerful men from another world who had just entered the Chaos Realm rushed out a large number of strong men and headed towards the deserted city.

"No, Senior Lu Xue, they are going to attack Huangcheng!"

A powerful Holy Spirit tribe exclaimed.

Hearing this, Lu Xue's expression remained unchanged, "I don't need to pay attention."

"ah?"

When Zhen Qingyang saw the large number of powerful men from another world who were striking towards the deserted city, he immediately laughed.

As the top array he had long buried in his heart, the Chaos Combination Array has naturally made countless improvements. It is no exaggeration to say that the only disadvantage of this array is that it is money-consuming.

Apart from this, there are no more shortcomings, absolutely both offense and defense.

The most clever thing about this formation is that the flaws in the formation are placed in front of you, which is the deserted city, but what can you do?

If you want to break the deserted city, go to dream.

Zhen Qingyang laughed, not worried that the formation would collapse because of this.

After all, Huangcheng is the masterpiece of that person. Not to mention some unsightly ants, even if the gods from the land of gods come, there is no way for Huangcheng.

Sure enough, the powerful people in the Chaos Realm did not stop the powerful people in the other world, and watched the powerful people in the other world come to the deserted city and start bombarding.

"Old ancestor, what are those people doing?"

In a courtyard in the inner city, a little girl holding a lollipop blinked her big eyes, looked up at the sky, and asked the old man beside her in confusion.

The ancestor of the Zhang family laughed: "A group of crazy people, don't pay attention to it, keep playing."

"Ao."

The little girl agreed and continued to squeeze the mud.

The ancestor of the Zhang family looked at it for a while, then slowly stood up and left the courtyard.

Outside the door, a middle-aged man had been waiting for a long time.

"Old ancestors, the Zhang family's children are ready and can go to battle at any time."

Upon hearing this, the ancestor of the Zhang family nodded slightly, "It's done well."

"However, now is not the time for me to appear, so wait patiently."

"Yes, ancestor."

The same scenes took place in every corner of the deserted city.

Although the deserted city is in a transcendent position in the Chaos Realm and is isolated from the world, the people of the deserted city will naturally not sit idly by as they see the Chaos Realm are suffering.

What's more, the daughters of the Lord of the Huangcheng City are already fighting, so what reason do they have to watch the show?

As long as Lu Xue gave her order, countless powerful people would inevitably rush out of the deserted city.

At this time, several powerful men from other worlds who were still bombing on the deserted city were just clowns in front of the people in the deserted city.

Just as everyone was watching, a team of deserted guards suddenly rose up and came to the deserted city, looking at each other from a distance with the strong men in another world through a protection barrier for the deserted city.

"Damn it, this broken city shell is so hard. Let's change the name of this world to the Tortoise Realm."

One of the powerful men in another world shouted angrily.

"Haha, since we can't open this city, why don't we target other areas?"

As they said that, they looked at the areas outside the deserted city, which were filled with countless creatures, most of which did not have the slightest resistance.

"Hahaha, it makes sense!"

Just as they were about to kill themselves down, a buzzing sound opened out of thin air over the deserted city.

"Hmm?! There are flaws!"

Seizing this opportunity, several powerful men from other worlds immediately flocked to the sky and appeared above the deserted city in the blink of an eye.

"I actually came in, then the massacre began!"

A powerful man from another world led by the leader let out a fierce laugh, and then he stared at the people in the deserted city below and suddenly appeared in the eyes of the fierce light.

"What's wrong."

At this time, a strong man from another world suddenly frowned slightly and looked at the group of figures in front of him.

The deserted guard.

The reason why the strong men in another world can enter the wasteland city is because they took the initiative to open the protection barrier of the wasteland city.

"After the order of Miss, kill the creatures in other worlds!"

The leader Huang Wei shouted loudly and then a terrifying aura burst out.

"What!?"

Feeling this powerful aura, several creatures from other worlds were stunned and trembled all over.

That is not an existence they can fight against.

In just a few breaths, several cold corpses slowly fell from the air.

When the people in Huangcheng saw this scene, there was no turmoil in their hearts, but they just shook their heads lightly.

On the other side, in the Huangcheng Square.

Since the war began, there were no top powerhouses on the combat power list, but the genius list on the side reached the climax.

Qinghai of the Tian Yao Clan defeated all the geniuses and reached the top of the list, showing the heroes, which caused an uproar in the audience.

No one expected that this Qinglong, the Heavenly Demon Clan, which had arrived long ago, would have such powerful strength.

Another eye-catching thing is that the Shadow Clan has no trace, and its Supreme Realm cultivation ranks at the bottom of the Tianjiao Pound, which made everyone stunned.

"What is this shadow without trace doing? The Supreme Realm is actually ranked 100th?"

"Damn it, our clan and geniuses are coming here. They obviously won a medium-sized ranking, but were stopped by this Ying Wujie."

"Is this intentional not to rush up, isn't anyone taking care of it?"

Everyone present expressed their dissatisfaction in their hearts.

But the move without trace did not violate the rules.

If you want to make it, you must first defeat the last one on the list, and the last one at this time is the weird thing about Ying Wujie. He is not losing at all when facing the challenger, and he does not choose to rush up.

In this way, the other geniuses who were clearly on the list were blocked by Ying Wujie, presenting such an embarrassing situation.

"The Shadow Clan is so mysterious, I don't know if I can defeat him."

In the crowd, Bai Ling murmured to himself.

Within the Tianjiao Point, Ying Wuzhi was lying in the martial arts field yawning, sticking one hand on his head, which was very comfortable.

"Haha, I'm such a clever one."

Although people will challenge themselves from time to time, those people are just a group of scumbags who don’t even have the ability to get close to them. If they put a space trap on their own, the other party will be unable to take care of themselves. How could they be his opponent?

As long as I persist until the end, my task will be completed.

As for the rewards in the top few places, he was not interested at all.

Outside the Tianjiao List, some people really couldn't stand it anymore and shouted: "Whose tribe and the Tianjiao have not played, hurry up and defeat this Shadow Tribe guy."

As soon as the words fell, everyone was speechless.

The geniuses in the clan have basically appeared, and they have long been on the list, so there is no possibility of a repeat.

And some can't even be defeated.

After all, Shadow Wujie is the supreme realm, and there are very few supreme realm in the entire Tianjiao List, and you can count it with one hand.

Therefore, there is basically no existence that can be punished without a trace at present.

Seeing everyone silent, the person who spoke was ugly.

And at this moment, a human strong man suddenly said, "It seems that there is one more person in the Human Emperor Palace."

"Human Emperor Palace?"

When everyone heard this, they felt unbelievable.

Aren’t the two geniuses in the Human Emperor Palace already on the list, and they are at the forefront.

The powerful human race nodded and said, "My grandfather is holding an important position in the Human Emperor Palace. I heard from him that there is a genius in the Human Emperor Palace taught by the Lord of the Human Emperor Palace, and he has almost never been born."

At present, all the top strong men in the Chaos Realm have participated in the battle, and everyone who left behind is ordinary strong men, so they don’t know much.

When everyone heard this, their eyes lit up.

"Have you just arrived that day? Where is it? What's the name?"

Everyone asked hurriedly.

The man shook his head and spread his hands and said, "How could I know so much? This is a secret. I only dared to say it during this period."

"Maybe, he is still not sure if he has arrived."

When everyone heard this, they felt something was right, so they looked around and started to look around in the audience.

At this moment, at the entrance of the square, a young man with a high ponytail, a plain face, wearing a cloth clothes, and a pair of straw sandals appeared and walked towards this side.

"Will this person be?"

"That's a big deal, your genius looks like this."

"Too."

Some people also noticed the boy, all of whom showed unexpected expressions.

This is the first time I have seen this image here.

"Look, that kid is on the list of geniuses!"

One person suddenly said in surprise.

Hearing this, someone waved his hand and said, "I'll probably be beaten out in a while."

Sure enough, after a while, the space trembled and a figure was teleported out.

"Look, let me tell you... Huh?!"

When they saw clearly the person being teleported out, everyone opened their mouths and looked unbelievable.

It’s just because the person who came out was not that human teenager, but no trace!
